Earnings Call Date: 2026-07-29
Earnings Call Sentiment
Positive
The call conveyed strong momentum in AI-driven infrastructure investment.
----- END PROVIDER SUMMARY -----
Operator: Welcome to the Meta Platforms Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call.
Susan Li — Chief Financial Officer
Capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, were $31.1 billion, driven by investments in servers, data centers and network infrastructure. Free cash flow was $784 million. We ended the quarter with $90.3 billion in cash and marketable securities and $83.7 billion in debt.
We anticipate 2026 capital expenditures, including principal payments on finance leases, to be in the range of $130 billion to $145 billion, narrowed from our prior outlook of $125 billion to $145 billion.
Mark Zuckerberg — Chief Executive Officer
Yesterday, as part of our Meta Compute effort, we announced a new strategic venture with BlackRock to develop a new 1 gigawatt data center in El Paso, Texas.
Susan Li — Chief Financial Officer
In funding these infrastructure investments, the strength of our balance sheet gives us the ability to attract capital from a wide range of markets to supplement the cash flow generated by our business. We strongly believe that the models, consumer experiences and enterprise offerings that we are building will be the best and highest ROI use of our infrastructure.
But we've also been evolving our capital structure in recent years to include a greater mix of debt as we work to bring down our cost of capital, and we have generally found it prudent to continue adding cost-efficient long-duration sources of capital as we make investments in initiatives that themselves have long time horizons, especially AI infrastructure projects.
